Assuming same-size replacement is automatically exempt — Kansas City still expects permit review for residential window replacement

pro_tips: Keep the window label or manufacturer sticker available for inspection — inspectors often want to verify the exact U-factor and SHGC from the product label
If any opening is in a bedroom, measure the clear opening before ordering the unit so you do not fail egress on final
Kansas City uses a combined permit structure, so do not waste time looking for separate electrical or mechanical permits for a plain window swap
Submit the permit with the exact window schedule and product cut sheets up front to avoid a plan review bounce
